notice.service: Apple service stopped: you are seeing the last saved list.
notice.nodevice: iPhone unplugged: you are seeing the last saved list. If you just started the service, plug the cable in again.
empty.service.title: The Apple service is stopped
empty.service.body: It is what lets this tool read the iPhone directly. Windows will ask for your approval; then unplug your iPhone and plug it back in.
empty.nodevice.title: Plug in your iPhone
empty.nodevice.body: Unlock it and answer “Trust” if it asks. If it is already plugged in, unplug it and plug it back in.
empty.error.title: The iPhone is not responding
empty.error.body: Unlock it, then unplug the cable and plug it back in.
empty.preparing.title: Preparing your library
empty.preparing.body: This happens only once: reading the iPhone's Photos database to find names, dates and hidden items. Next launches will be instant.
empty.connecting.title: Connecting to the iPhone…
empty.noresult.title: Nothing for “{query}”
empty.noresult.body: This file is neither on the iPhone nor in its Photos library. If it comes from another app (Files, WhatsApp…), it cannot be reached over the cable.
empty.nothing.title: Nothing here
lb.label: Preview
lb.cloudHint: This original is not on the iPhone. Open it in the iPhone's Photos app to download it from iCloud: it will then appear here.
lb.videoUnplayable: This PC cannot play this video here (iPhone HEVC format). Copy it to the PC to watch it.
lb.reducedCloud: Reduced preview: the original is only in iCloud.
lb.reducedPhoto: Reduced preview: copy the photo to the PC to see it in full.
delete.impossible.title: Cannot delete from here
delete.impossible.body: Edited items, Live Photos, hidden items, items already deleted and iCloud-only items must be deleted in the Photos app on the iPhone.
delete.warn.one: It will not go to Recently Deleted, and it may also disappear from iCloud and your other devices.
delete.warn.other: They will not go to Recently Deleted, and they may also disappear from iCloud and your other devices.
delete.experimental: Experimental feature, tested on few devices. Keep the copy on your PC.
delete.backup: Keep a copy on the PC ({size}) in {path}
delete.skipped.one: {n} skipped: edited items, Live Photos, hidden or iCloud. Delete them in Photos on the iPhone.
delete.skipped.other: {n} skipped: edited items, Live Photos, hidden or iCloud. Delete them in Photos on the iPhone.
delete.final.title: Final check
delete.final.nobackup: No copy will be kept on the PC.
job.deleteHint: The first search can take a few minutes.
errors.service_stopped: The Apple service is not running.
errors.not_trusted: This iPhone has not authorized this PC. Unlock it and answer “Trust”.
errors.session_refused: The iPhone refused the connection. Unlock it and try again.
errors.connection_lost: The connection to the iPhone was lost.
errors.afc_refused: The iPhone refused file access. Unlock it and try again.
errors.busy: The iPhone is busy. Try again.
errors.too_many_copies: Too many copies of this file on the PC.
errors.disk_full: Not enough space on the PC's disk.
errors.nothing_deletable: No file can be deleted in this selection.
errors.too_many_files: {max} files at most at a time.
errors.helper_missing: The Windows compiler needed for deletion was not found.
errors.helper_failed: The deletion helper could not be built.
errors.not_found_windows: Not found on the Windows side: plug the iPhone in again and retry.
errors.windows_no_device: Windows does not see the iPhone.
errors.object_missing: File not found on the Windows side: plug the iPhone in again and retry.
errors.content_mismatch: The content does not match: deletion refused.
errors.demo_mode: Disabled in demo mode: no real iPhone here.
